title: This 3-Pound Frog Eats Its Own Babies, Then Digs a Canal to Save Them

scenes.text: The worst father in the animal kingdom is also one of the best.
The African bullfrog weighs up to three pounds and swallows mice, small birds, snakes and other frogs whole.
The female leaves up to 4,000 eggs in a shallow pool and goes. The male stays to guard them. He also eats a few.
Then the African sun starts drying the pool. Thousands of tadpoles are about to cook in a shrinking puddle.
So the father digs. With his head and his back legs he cuts a channel to a bigger pond, and water pours in.
The tadpoles swim down the canal to safety. He ate some of them. He saved the rest. Same frog.

description:
The African bullfrog is one of the few frogs whose father guards the tadpoles, and when their pool starts to dry he digs a channel to a larger pond with his head and hind legs so they can escape.
Males reach about 1.4 kg (3.1 lb), eat rodents, birds, reptiles and other frogs, and sometimes eat some of their own tadpoles while guarding them; a clutch can hold 3,000 to 4,000 eggs.
Would you call him a good dad or a bad one?
subject: african bullfrog
first_comment: In the dry season the same frog seals itself in a cocoon of shed skin underground and waits for rain. Which animal has the strangest parenting style you know?
